movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Fluid, expressive movements often following the rhythm of the guitar.
movement_profile.footwork: Small, rapid steps shifting weight between legs.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Central focus; rapid, rhythmic hip swaying and isolation.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Mostly grounded, focusing on hip and leg movement.
movement_profile.partnering: Optional; often performed as a solo freestyle dance.
movement_profile.posture: Upright and relaxed, allowing for fluid hip movement.

signature_moves.description: High-energy, improvised movement during the instrumental bridge.
signature_moves.name: Sebene dance

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid rigid, static posture; ensure hip movement is fluid.

music_profile.musical_form: Alternation between vocal passages and the sebene (instrumental bridge).
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: 16th-note bass cadence with offbeat guitar emphasis.
music_profile.sound_description: Bright, high-pitched electric guitar lines weaving through a fast, driving bassline and crisp percussion.

teaching.formation: Freestyle, often in clubs or social dance settings.
teaching.level_notes: Requires high cardiovascular stamina and fluid hip mobility.
teaching.rhythm: 4/4 time signature with a fast-paced 16th-note cadence.
